PRESIDENT OF INDIA GRACES THE VALEDICTORY CEREMONY OF THE CENTENARY CELEBRATIONS OF SHRI RAM COLLEGE OF COMMERCE


INDIA HAS THE BEST POOL OF YOUNG TALENT IN THE WORLD AS DEMONSTRATED IN COLLEGES LIKE SRCC: PRESIDENT DROUPADI MURMU

Posted On: 18 NOV 2026 6:40PM by PIB Delhi

The President of India, Smt Droupadi Murmu graced the Valedictory Ceremony of the Centenary Celebrations of Shri Ram College of Commerce (SRCC) in New Delhi today (November 18, 2026).

Speaking on the occasion, the President said that the country's leading educational institutions must evolve into world-class institutions. It will not only help in realizing the national vision of transforming India into a Global Knowledge Superpower but also attract talented students from both within India and abroad for higher education.

 

The President said that during the last ten years, India has remained one of the fastest-growing large economies in the world. The country has achieved unprecedented expansion of infrastructure, revolutionary digital transformation, financial inclusion and social development. There is a conducive start-up ecosystem. ‘Ease of Doing Business’ has been given high priority. At the same time, effective welfare measures have been implemented with the approach of leaving no targeted beneficiary uncovered. Around 50 crore fellow citizens have come out of extreme poverty in recent years. These achievements have been made possible amidst several challenges in the global environment, characterised by uncertainties and ongoing conflicts. The students at this college are fortunate to witness the resilience and success of our economy and learn from it. They will utilise this learning to further accelerate our journey of development.

 

The President said that Bharat is expanding its economic role on the global stage with a new energy and outlook. Our youth will be driving our ambitious endeavours. India has the largest young population in the world and  it also has the best pool of young talent in the world as demonstrated in colleges like SRCC.

 

The President said that ‘Of India, by India, and for India’ is the approach with which our youth should define their aspirations and roles. In this context, ‘by India’ implies that the society and institutions have contributed to the development of capabilities of students. Therefore, they have a special responsibility towards the society and the country.

 

The President was happy to note that the students of SRCC have been scoring high marks and securing top positions in examinations. She said that students of SRCC should demonstrate that wealth creation leads to nation-building; should do well for themselves and also create opportunities for others, especially for the less privileged; should achieve world-class excellence while remaining rooted in the noble Indian values; should use state-of-the-art technologies responsibly with sensitivity; and should pursue professional excellence with empathy, ethics and morality. She expressed confidence that members of the SRCC family will continue to contribute towards the building of Viksit Bharat by 2047 and the glorious journey of our country even beyond.
